text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A closure is a function plus the variables it captured

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: make_counter() has already returned - yet `count` is still alive inside the returned function.

svg.text: Two traps every team eventually hits

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Late binding in loops: [lambda: i for i in range(3)] -> all three return 2. The closure captures the VARIABLE, not its value.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix with a default argument: [lambda i=i: i for i in range(3)].

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Writing to a captured name needs `nonlocal` (or `global`); reading it does not.
